# Wlad.me

> Personal site of Wlad, a senior UI engineer. Boring SaaS is a dated series of revenue notes on software products.

## Boring SaaS

- [Boring SaaS](https://www.wlad.me/blog): Index of editions and companies.
- [About these notes](https://www.wlad.me/blog/about): How Stripe-verified and self-reported labels work.

## Companies

- [1Lookup](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/1lookup): Real-time phone, email, and IP validation/enrichment API — 34 data products on one API key and one shared credit balance (validation, enrichment, B2B prospecting, SEO, transcription). Usage/credit pricing; integrations with Twilio, HubSpot, Shopify, Salesforce. Founded Jan 2022, US. Listed for sale at $10M on TrustMRR.
- [Aila](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/aila): Agentic AI for US mortgage teams — intake/compliance agents that listen to discovery calls, build the loan file in LOS/CRM (ARIVE, LendingPad, etc.), request docs, score compliance. From ~$50/LO/mo (intake+compliance); enterprise ~$200/LO/mo. Homepage also at withaila.com.
- [Angel Match](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/angel-match): Searchable database of ~124k–125k angel investors and VCs for founders raising seed. Freemium + paid subscription. US, founded 2019.
- [Anonymous workforce-management SaaS](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/anonymous-workforce-management-saas): Scheduling/time/compliance for employers.
- [Attivita24](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/attivita24): Italian marketplace to buy and sell small and medium-sized businesses (shops, bars, SMEs) directly owner-to-buyer, without brokers. Listing packages Base €34 / Plus €86 / Premium €149 + VAT. Founded Oct 2025, Italy. Listed for sale at $800k (first listed Feb 2026).
- [BackPedal](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/backpedal): London theft-recovery subscription for bikes and e-bikes. Mechanics install covert GSM/GPS/BLE trackers (17 disguised casings), a 24/7 in-house team recovers stolen bikes (company-stated ~80% recovery rate, ~48h typical), and backup theft insurance is underwritten by Sundays (FCA regulated). Annual protection from £153 (~£12.75/mo). Founded Sep 2021, UK.
- [Book The Move](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/book-the-move): Done-for-you outbound for moving & storage companies. It finds homeowners in the client's area who have just listed their homes, verifies contact info, and sends personalized emails on the mover's behalf to book jobs. Growth $397 / Pro $697 / Scale $1,197 per month. Founded Jan 2025, US. Listed for sale at $375,000 (6.1x; first listed Apr 1, 2026; 16 offers per TrustMRR).
- [Calendesk](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/calendesk): B2B booking + payments + client portal for therapists, psychologists, coaches, lawyers, beauty/fitness — white-label, subscription packages, API-first. Polish-founded, bootstrapped since 2020.
- [Capgo](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/capgo): Live OTA updates + native builds, channels, rollback, and release automation for CapacitorJS apps — ship JS/CSS fixes without waiting on App Store review. Estonia, bootstrapped, team 2–5. Free 14-day trial.
- [CartBoss](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/cartboss): Pay-as-you-go SMS abandoned-cart recovery for Shopify/WooCommerce stores. No monthly subscription; first 25 messages free; GDPR-compliant. Founded Mar 2021, Slovenia.
- [Codédex](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/codedex): Gamified beginner coding + Club sub from ~$9.99/mo.
- [ColdSire](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/coldsire): Premium cold-email inbox infrastructure — Google/Microsoft mailboxes from a pool mixed with real businesses, ~$6/mo per account, pitched at deliverability.
- [Cometly](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/cometly): Marketing attribution and analytics for B2B SaaS — sends accurate attribution data back to ad platforms; AI chat over ads data. Founded Oct  mid-2020, US. High ACV (291 subs → ~$206k MRR).
- [Comp AI](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/comp-ai): Open-source-friendly compliance SaaS that automates evidence collection, policy generation, and continuous monitoring for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. Sold to startups through enterprise as "compliance that helps you close deals." Founded Jan 2025, US. ~1,000 estimated users on TrustMRR.
- [Conductor](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/conductor): The QuickBooks Desktop & Enterprise API — real-time access to every QBD object via Python, Node/TypeScript, and REST. Abstracts Web Connector, qbXML, SOAP, and the rest of Intuit's legacy mess.
- [ControlResell](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/controlresell): Ops OS for pro resellers (Vinted, Shopify, etc.) — listings, negotiation, relisting, sales/purchase tracking. France-first.
- [ConvertLabs](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/convertlabs): All-in-one booking + marketing SaaS for home-service businesses (cleaning, lawn care, carpet cleaning, etc.) — bookings, payments, websites, and teams on one screen. Plans ~$67 / $197 / $397 per month. Founded Apr 2018, US. ~1,000 estimated users; 474 active subs.
- [Corsidia](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/corsidia): Italian course-comparison directory. It picks schools, training bodies and teachers, so users can compare course offers and prices and then contact the organizers directly. Corsidia.org covers publicly funded active-labour-policy training. Free for course seekers. Founded Jan 2018, Italy.
- [DataExpert / TechCreator](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/dataexpert-techcreator): Data engineering + AI upskilling education (courses / community) at dataexpert.io — ~$119/mo.
- [Dotmarket.eu](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/dotmarket-eu): French marketplace for buying / selling digital businesses (SaaS, media, e-commerce, web agencies). Claims 300+ vetted and valued deals a year (company-stated). Registered in Estonia, founded Jan 2020.
- [Easy Moving Permits](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/easy-moving-permits): Online platform to apply for and manage moving / street / dumpster / scaffolding parking permits across cities — transparent pricing including city fees + service charge; charged per application via Stripe.
- [Enquiry Genie](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/enquiry-genie): Chrome extension that drafts Airbnb/direct-booking enquiry replies in the host's tone with live pricing & availability (Gmail/Outlook + iCal/Airbnb sync). £1 for 14 days, then ~£29/mo for up to 5 properties. UK, bootstrapped.
- [Evergreen Support](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/evergreen-support): Done-for-you customer-support email team for small online sellers / online businesses, billed monthly or weekly ("Start onboarding for $1", free support audit). Founded Jul 2022, US.
- [Expensent](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/expensent): Finds receipts/invoices in Gmail/Outlook/IMAP and forwards them to your accountant, QuickBooks, Xero, Expensify, etc. — one-click catch-up + auto-forward rules. Solo, bootstrapped, Portugal. Solo ~$19/mo, Pro ~$59/mo.
- [Fast Corp Ltd](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/fast-corp-ltd): All-in-one Bulgarian EU company launch + ongoing compliance. Online EOOD/OOD formation in ~3–5 business days (formation from ~€1,500–€1,750), then optional bookkeeping/VAT/payroll (accounting from ~€229/mo). EU IBAN/banking support, virtual office, 10% corporate tax pitch. Bootstrapped, Sofia, team 2–5, ~3,000 clients claimed since 2018.
- [Festejar](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/festejar): Ticketing + branded web platform for local clubs / nightclubs / venues in Catalonia — agenda, ticket sales, store, and subscriptions under one always-updated site with unified branding. Founded Mar 2026, Spain.
- [FF Dispatch](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/ff-dispatch): Truck-dispatch and back-office service for US owner-operators (incl. box trucks). Dispatchers find and negotiate 3–5 load options a day and handle rate confirmations, PODs and invoicing. Optional add-ons cover authority/company formation, DOT compliance, factoring & fuel, banking, and bookkeeping & taxes. Pricing: 5–8% commission, no contracts. The founder says on TrustMRR that carriers are invoiced via Stripe after the job is done and paid, and that they are building their own TMS with payments. Founded Oct 2023, US, team of 26–50 (founder-stated).
- [FireCert](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/firecert): UK fire & security compliance software for contractors: asset registers built from panel/CSV exports, locked + hashed certificates (BS 5839-1/-6, BS 5266 emergency lighting, BS 5306 extinguishers, PD 6662 intruder, CCTV, access control, dry risers), QR asset tags, visit reminders, client portal, Xero integration. £79/mo Professional, £129/mo Business. Founded Feb 2026, UK. Company-stated 4.9/5 from 47 customers.
- [Flocksy](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/flocksy): Flat-rate design/video subscription, ~$1,199–$2,999+/mo.
- [FriendFilter + GroupFilter](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/friendfilter-groupfilter): Established Chrome extensions for Facebook friend and group management — spot inactive / low-quality / fake connections so posts reach people who engage. Free / Growth ~$29 / Pro ~$49 per month. Rails + Vue + Postgres. Founded Mar 2019, US. ~120k estimated users; 337 active subs. Listed for asset sale (includes ~100k dormant email list).
- [GESWORK](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/geswork): Modular management software for French service companies (ops / productivity suite).
- [Guidejar](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/guidejar): Interactive product demos / how-to guides / internal docs — record a process (Chrome or desktop), edit, AI voiceover/translate, share or embed; help-center hosting. Free up to 5 guides; paid unlimited. India-founded, ~10k users claimed.
- [HarperAI](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/harperai): UK public-records data product for specialist lenders, commercial brokers and property developers. It links every Companies House charge to Land Registry titles, corporate structures and officer networks. On top of that it adds search, refinance alerts (e.g. borrowers 14–27 months into a bridging loan with nothing filed since) and lender market-share analytics. £300–£3,152/mo (founder-stated). Founded Sep 2025, UK, bootstrapped. Listed for sale at $199,000 (2.3x; first listed Sep 20, 2026).
- [Helios](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/helios): Engagement / lifecycle platform for growing fitness brands — turn the flood of leads and member activity into actual conversations and retention (sendhelios.com).
- [Heron Copier](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/heron-copier): Multi-platform trade copier + trading journal — copy between cTrader, MT4/MT5, TradeLocker, MatchTrader, DXtrade, Telegram; cloud or local, no VPS required.
- [Hirevire](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/hirevire): Async video interview tool — candidates answer your questions on camera; hiring managers review without scheduling. Plans ~$49 / $149 / $249/mo. India-founded, bootstrapped, team 2–5.
- [HypeProxies](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/hypeproxies): ISP + residential proxy infrastructure with unlimited bandwidth, built for high-volume data collection / scraping / e-com automation. Plans from ~$65–$300/mo with quarterly discounts. Founded Oct 2019, US. ~20k estimated users; claims $100M+ in e-com purchases powered through the network.
- [Image-Charts](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/image-charts): Chart-as-image API for emails, PDFs, and chatbots (Google Image Charts spiritual successor). Bootstrapped since 2017.
- [ImmoWP](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/immowp): French "passerelle immobilière": syncs listings from an agency's real-estate software (company-stated 75+ compatible tools, e.g. Hektor, Apimo, Netty, Immofacile, Ubiflow, Whise, SweepBright) into the agency's existing WordPress site. Price, photos, DPE energy labels and "sold" status update several times a day, with failed-import monitoring and a free listings plugin. €500 HT one-time (install + first year), then €150 HT/yr. Company-stated 200+ agencies since 2017. TrustMRR founded date: Sep 2021.
- [JourneyFuse](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/journeyfuse): All-in-one CRM for travel advisors and small agencies, "from first inquiry to paid-in-full": client journeys, trip/booking tracking, client comms, payments, replacing "a dozen disconnected tools." $25/mo. Founded Mar 2026, US.
- [Juiced](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/juiced): Lead-distribution platform for lead-gen businesses. It routes each inbound lead in real time to the right buyer (SMS, email, or straight into the buyer's CRM). Waterfall logic covers prepaid partner quotas, direct auction to the highest bid, a reverse-auction marketplace for "fresh" and then "aged" leads, and round-robin leftovers. Target: lead-gen pros and agencies generating $1M+/month (founder-stated). Founded Feb 2024, US.
